# Alpha Realism Guide - Emulate True Photography in Generative Models

Alpha Realism is a 4-lesson guide ($9) designed to bypass the sterile, plastic, synthetic look generated by default AI prompts. It introduces a physical, cause-and-effect prompting framework.

## Core Pages
- [Alpha Realism Homepage](https://www.aialpharealism.online/): The official landing page featuring the comparison slider.

## The 5 Layers of Reality
A system to emulate real-world optics and physics in language:
1. **Lens Physics & Optics**: Simulating focal length, aperture, and glass imperfections (chromatic aberration, dust).
2. **Surface Detail**: Calibrating natural textures, pores, flyaway hairs, and surface roughness.
3. **Light & Volumetric Behavior**: Bypassing uniform ambient light with directional, organic light sources.
4. **Environmental Context**: Embedding subjects in plausible physical environments.
5. **Camera Body & Sensor Chemistry**: Emulating sensor noise, grain structure, and color science of specific camera bodies (Fujifilm, Hasselblad, Leica).
